name: cache_lru_eviction_missing
description: Performance regression from missing LRU eviction logic causing unbounded cache growth

variants.name: exact_evidence
variants.description: Provides profiling data showing cache growth beyond capacity

success_criteria.description: Cache hit/miss behavior unchanged, results correct

ground_truth.root_cause: Removed move_to_end() and eviction logic, cache grows unbounded beyond capacity
ground_truth.fix_strategy: Restore LRU maintenance: move_to_end() on get(), popitem(last=False) eviction on set()
ground_truth.expected_speedup: Prevents memory bloat; maintains O(1) operations with bounded size
